advancement.cardboarded_conveynience.lik: RIDE ON CHAIN CONVEYR LIEK ANY OTHR PAKAGE
_comment.cardboarded_conveynience.nermal: Nermal as in the Garfield character often mailed away in boxes. Pun on 'normal'. Translators: try making a pun with your localized name!
advancement.cardboarded_conveynience.ner: GETZ URSELF DELIVRD 2 A FROGPORT WIF NAMETAG
cardboarded_conveynience.ponder.cardboar: WEAR ALL TEH CARBORD ARMOR ON CHAIN CONVEYR...
cardboarded_conveynience.ponder.belt_tun: A DISGUISD PLAYR ON BELT CAN GO THRU TUNNLZ...
ANDESIET TUNNLZ LETZ CRAWLIN PPLZ THRU 2...
BRAS TUNNLZ OF DOOM CAN FILTR WOT GOEZ THRU...
...BUT U CAN TRIK EM WIF TEH RITE ITEM.
A WRENCH FILTR NO LET CARBORD PAKAGE THRU...
BUT WEN TEH FILTR SEZ OK 2 PAKAGEZ...
...A PAKAGE DISGUIS WILL MATCH - U GOEZ RITE THRU!
WEN TEH FILTR MATCHEZ ARMOR UR WEARIN...
...LIEK TEH HELMET ON UR HED, SO UR LET IN!
WEN U HOLDZ TEH MATCH ITEM IN EITHR HAND...
...TEH FILTR WILL LET U THRU AS WEL.
BUT... WEN U IZ A PAKAGE...
cardboarded_conveynience.ponder.chute_te: SNEEK ON TEH CHUTE IN FUL CARBORD ARMOR...
DIAGNL CHUTEZ WERK 2 - GO IN DIS 1...
SMRT CHUTE WIF WRONG FILTR NO SENDZ U...
WIF A PAKAGE FILTR, U FALLZ LIEK A REEL PAKAGE!
COZ NUFFIN GETZ THRU LOKD SMRT CHUTE...
cardboarded_conveynience.ponder.frogport: NORMLY, PPLZ RIDE TEH CHAIN CONVEYRZ AN IGNOR TEH FROGPORTZ...
...AN WEN 2 PATHZ MEET, U GOEZ WER U LUKZ.
WEN U IZ A PAKAGE, NAMETAG IN UR OTHR HAND SENDZ U AUTOMAJIK...
...2 TEH RITE FROGPORT, ANYWER ON TEH NETWERK.
...ANY MATCHIN FROGPORT IZ A GUD PLAECE 2 GO.
